title: Dontmakemefallinlove
lyrics:
[00:09.14]I don't think I'm meant to be with you
[00:13.12]I don't wanna make you sad
[00:15.49]All the time just feeling bad
[00:18.15]Girl, don't make me fall in love with you
[00:22.39]I don't think I'm right for you
[00:24.62]I'm just disappointing you
[00:27.57]Lonely nights like these, you just stumble in my head
[00:31.85]And I'm wondering what you're doin'
[00:33.95]And why maybe I'm not dead
[00:36.35]The thought of you still kills me, I know I'm the stupid guy
[00:40.86]Looking back at my mistakes, I fucked up a million times
[00:45.67]I couldn't see the day I'd ever call somebody mine
[00:50.17]'Cause every single heartbreak made me lose my fuckin' mind
[00:54.80]I guess I was too blind, girl, to see that you were right for me
[00:59.55]I had to fuck it up, I'm sorry, this is not goodbye
[01:04.10]I let this so called fame get deep into my head
[01:08.60]And I'd end up doin' thoughtless things that I soon would regret
[01:13.26]I made you feel special and I should've felt the same
